CLIPPING_AND_OVERLAP.mechanismFound: Not a fitter defect. Every widget of 'Applicant Name', 'Street Address', 'City State Zip', 'Phone' and 'Email' on the CPL 160.59 pro se packet carries its OWN /DA of '/Arial 11 Tf 0 0 0 rg', while the field-level /DA is '/Helv 0 Tf'. applyFitToTextField writes the fitted size onto the FIELD, and the widget's own entry is what the appearance generator uses -- so the fitted 7.5, 9.5, 7 and 8 points were discarded and every value drew at 11. reports/actual-writes.json recorded outcome 'shrunk' and the bytes ignored it: the report was true about the fit and false about the ink.
CLIPPING_AND_OVERLAP.measuredBefore: pro-se-packet-boundary.pdf carried 605 text runs whose extent crosses the 612-point page edge; the pristine bound source carries 598. Seven of them were participant ink.
CLIPPING_AND_OVERLAP.measuredAfter: 605 -> 598, exactly the pristine source's own count. Zero runs of participant ink now leave the page box. The application (153) and certificate-of-disposition (43) fixtures equal their pristine sources before and after.
CLIPPING_AND_OVERLAP.repair: An opt-in alignWidgetFontSizeToFit option on the shared finalizer, declared by this family's three rendered documents. It rewrites ONLY the size token inside a widget's existing /DA, preserving the font resource name and the colour operators, and it is a no-op where the fit already equals the widget's declared size -- which is why every canonical fixture, whose values all fit at 11, is byte-identical.
CLIPPING_AND_OVERLAP.whyOptIn: The option follows the precedent the module already sets for evaluateDeclaredMinimumSize: forty-odd builders share this finalizer under other workers' claims, and a repair lane holding four families does not decide what the others' next rebuild produces. The default is unchanged and no family outside this one passes the flag.

REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING.mechanismFound: The off-by-one is a tie in captureWidgetContext. It takes the caption printed to the LEFT of a widget on the same line and breaks ties on horizontal gap alone. On the certificate-of-disposition request's page-2 identifier column every caption ends at the same x, so eleven candidate gaps are equal to 3.1 points and a run of ten widgets each took the caption of the row above: IDVNumber captioned 'Docket, Indictment, or SCI Number', PartialDocketNumber captioned 'NYSID Number', and so on down the stack.
REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING.whyNotFixedInTheCaptureModule: A vertical-distance tie-break was implemented and measured against both New York forms before the table was written. It corrects the identifier stacks and regresses about a dozen other widgets onto the underscore rules printed beneath them, so it trades one wrong-caption class for another; and captureWidgetContext is shared far beyond these fifteen families.
REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING.repair: A per-document caption table of what the FORM PRINTS beside each named widget, read off the printed face of all three rendered sources, plus a guard that refuses a caption whose bytes did not decode. 55 captions corrected across the three documents. Nothing is invented and nothing is reworded; where a caption is a column heading rather than an inline label, the row it belongs to is named after a dash.
REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING.oneCaptionDeliberatelyNotUsed: Address_of_DA_1 and Address_of_DA_2 print '[address(es) of District Attorney's office(s)]' as a bracketed note under the pair of rules. Using that as the caption made the completeness contract classify both as ATTORNEY_BLOCK, a class the participant does not complete, and the family failed FAIL_MISSING_PREFILLS with unclassifiedBlanks 2. These two rules ARE the participant's to fill in on their own affidavit, so the form's inline caption 'at the following address(es)' is used instead. Recorded because it is a real edge in the contract's label vocabulary, not a workaround anyone should have to rediscover.

oh_marijuana_expungement-set.theSecondDefect: Paragraph 9 of the application promises 'the certified disposition and list every charge arising from the same act' and Ohio Rev. FOR A CAPTAIN: this needs a lane that holds the shared pleading renderer.

sharedHostChange.sharedFinalizerAddition: alignWidgetFontSizeToFit, default false, plus alignWidgetDefaultAppearanceSizes() and a report.widgetFontSizeAligned ledger. sharedHostChange.captainDecisionRecorded: Both opt-in flags on the shared finalizer carry the same note: the default should flip to true once every family can be rebuilt together. A shrunk fit that the bytes ignore is a defect wherever it occurs, not only in New York.
